what: ABSOLUTE tumour purity/ploidy master calls, PanCanAtlas. Yardstick 2 in Anatomy_Test.md — a DNA-derived measurement of the same quantity the Tumor column estimates from RNA, so it shares no failure mode with any method under test.
purity_column: 'Cancer DNA fraction' is the column the predecessor project's flowchart requires; 'purity' is also present and is ABSOLUTE's own purity estimate. Both are non-null for the same 156 samples.

overlap_with_tcga_gbm_bulk.bulk_source: TCGA-GBM.star_counts.tsv in the predecessor project, which is read-only from here

status: File obtained. The yardstick is NOT yet computable: it requires all 15 methods to be run on the TCGA-GBM cohort and each method's Tumor fraction correlated against purity. Until then load_absolute_purity() correctly reports UNAVAILABLE.
